Frequently Asked Questions:
What is RTP in the context of an online casino?

RTP is the acronym for Return to Player. Essentially it is the percentage the game pays out.

Are real money online casinos legal in Ontario?

Online casinos are legal in Ontario. They must be authorized, licensed, and regulated by the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario ("AGCO"). NorthStar Bets is licensed and can legally offer real money casino and slot games.

What is the safest online casino?

NorthStar Bets is authorized, licensed, and regulated by the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario ("AGCO"). Therefore, it follows best practice in player safety and security. NorthStar Bets is a made-in-Ontario casino and sportsbook gaming platform that provides players with a uniquely local, premier user experience.

What is the difference between a “live dealer” and “standard” online casino game?

A “live dealer” casino game has a real person as the dealer with the game streamed on video. A standard casino game is software only and models a real game through a random number generator.
